full_page.content:
Page 204 Cont.
Apri. 15 Margaret Malone - young lady - 29 - from New Brunswick - here to have operation to save Eye - one already lost.
16 Mrs. Angela Martin - 40 - operation at 9 o'clock To-day.
Thomas Anthony Gibson - 50 - Philadelphia - deaf, dumb, and blind since 14 .... has a sister similarly aflicted. Parents were Ist cousins.
Anthony Toby - 40 - brain tuomer removed last November, somewhat paralyzed - Epileptic.
Apr. 17 Helena Pienta - 40 - intestinal cancer - Enrolled yesterday almost hopeless - by husband - who promised weekly communion for year if wife were spared .... decidedly improved Today "Two further operations necessary."
Page 205
Apr. 19 Helen Frances Walker - 2 - believed to have fallen some time after birth and while seemingly bright cannot talk or walk ...
Sylvester J. Pheney - 65 - Gangreen apendix - delerious at times - in Ford's Hosp .... Enrolled
Anthony Hoffman - 53 - cancer of spine ... Seems quite hopeless except by miracle.
Baby Diane Alice Champagne - 10 mo. - eczema fearful - They have to bind her little hands.
Mary Foley - 51 - unsettled and nerve ...
Shirley Arnold - 13 - physically and mentally abnormal - was 6 before taken to monastery and prayed for ..... shortly after began to speak.
Blanche Frebis - Elderly - had a good position but having left it to care for her invalid parents is now out of employment - She adopt - a little orphan, now 16 whom she is trying to educate while helping her widowed sister & family ....
Page 206 Apr. 23 Baby Catherine Posquett - 2 - found a match and caught fire - badly burned - Mother also trying to save her was badly burned .....
